text: Mars (Japanese: , Kioku Kūkan - Hisei) is a landmark in . It is located in Memory Space, and is one of the final locations in the game. The only enemy found here is Spirit - Telethia, and there is a transporter to the Moon.

The Mechonis Key is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is given to the party by Rizaka as a reward for completing The Wilted Flower. The Mechonis Key is needed to gain access to the Power Pipe Ruins and to complete The Oath Sword.

The Mechonis Wound (Japanese: , Kishin no Tsumeato) is a landmark in . It is located on the upper level of Valak Mountain. As its name implies, it is the place where Mechonis struck Bionis in their climactic battle. This landmark is useful when accessing the Chilkin Lair.

Maurice Chausson (Japanese: , Mōrisu Shōson; English dub: , or as in French), or Director General Chausson, is a character in . He was formerly an American defense minister, and later presidential aide. He self-appointed himself as the chief executive of the New Los Angeles autonomous government. Maurice arrogantly believes he is a representative of humanity on Mira. However, he doesn't seem to be acting for the sake of personal gain, but rather to carry on the ideals of a woman named Mira Torres who planet Mira is named after.

Maximum Voltage is one of Alexa's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing the Affinity Mission Rapid Misfire. It gains a significant damage boost if the user's Skell is destroyed during the same battle.

Merciful Diluses (Japanese: , Māshī Kurogosu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Dilus family. They can be found at level 33-38 at Rustpool Banks and Rust Lake in Noctilum. Three must be defeated for Dilus Destroyer.

Megajolt Rattles (Japanese: , Shōgeki no Ratoru) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, in particular by swimming around to the back of the continent then going up the hill next to FN Site 515. Seven are required for the Basic Mission Megajolt Rattle and Roll.
Melee Power Up is a buff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases melee attack damage.
Melee Power Down is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces melee attack damage.

Medoozes (Japanese: , Jerī, Jelly) are a family of aquatic flying enemies in the . They resemble jellyfish and are mostly grey-green with the exception of a variety unique to the Kingdom of Torna in , which glows green and purple.

Memory Bracelet is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Wind Mastery", "Birdbrain" and "Leaping" Field Skills.
Mayfly is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Decimation Cannon.

The Maxos Arachno (Japanese: , Makishimu Supaido) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 33 at the Jelidorend Highlands in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the DLC Blade Quest Shiny New Power.

Martha is an NPC in . She is an elderly Tornan monster enthusiast who can be found at Hyber Village in the Kingdom of Torna. Martha mentions traveling through multiple continents to document the Unique Monsters there, in particular the unseen Titan Estham. During New Game Plus, she will give the player the Subjugation Report. Upon defeating any 16 Unique Monsters (Golden Monsters included) from the Kingdom of Torna or from Gormott, she will join the Community.

Massive Melee Mythra (Japanese: , Taninzū Sentōyō Ishō no Hikari) is a DLC Aux Core made available for free with the 2.0.2 Update of and . It boosts the Critical Hit Rate of the Blade by 25%. It also changes Mythra's appearance when she equips the core. This Aux Core can be obtained from Brobro on the Salvage Deck of the Argentum Trade Guild after completing Chapter 3 in , and from the Nameless Wanderpon in Feltley Village in after Addam and Mythra join the party. It is the most powerful Critical Hit Rate enhancing Aux Core in the game. The Blue Sky Pyra and Mythra-Style Pyra DLC Aux Cores have weaker versions of the same effect, which are functionally identical to the Critical Up V Aux Core

Memorial Hall (Japanese: , Kinendō) is a Landmark in . It is located by Virid Park in the City. Inside are six statues depicting the founders and a seventh central plinth. Each of the six statues and central plinth has a description on them.
The Medical Facility (Japanese: , Iryōshisetsu) is a Location in , located in the City. K's Portrait is displayed here if the party sells it to Wellwell after completing An Artist.
Maximushrooms are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the City Caravan, or produced from the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Mercurii Rings are Accessories in and . Only one can be obtained per playthrough, from the Legacy of the Seven container at Anu Shoals, by jumping off a rope between two islands onto a smaller spire. In , they can be dropped from Fogdweller Abaasy.
Master Attack Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Master Defense Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Master Healing Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.
Master Assorted Gems are an unused Key Item in . They would have unlocked the ability to craft certain gems, but as all gems can be crafted immediately, they are not used in-game.

Modern Resistors (Japanese: , Modan Rejisuta) are collectables in . They can be found in Prison Island. According to their description, they were once used for memory storage, though now they might make for a nice ornament.

Metal Blast (Japanese: , Metaru Burasuto) is one of Sharla's physical arts in . Sharla fires a shot in a straight line, hitting any enemies along its path. Successful hits will inflict Break. When used against flying enemies, this art has a 25% greater chance of scoring a Critical Hit. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Ittle Blast.

Miss Sweetness' Gratitude (Japanese: , Ojōsama no Ongaeshi) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Ma'crish after completing her Miss Sweetness Showdown and reaching 4-star affinity with Colony 6. Accepting this quest automatically triggers A Final Sweet Favour. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. This quest is mutually exclusive with Berryjammy's Miss Sweetness' Gratitude, which becomes available if Berryjammy's Miss Sweetness Showdown was completed instead of Ma'crish's. It is impossible for both Miss Sweetness' Gratitude quests to be available at the same time.

Miranium (English dub: ) is a material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found on the planet Mira, and can be mined from certain areas. Data Probes can also be installed to automatically extract it. On the world map view, the Mining Total will show the total amount of Miranium currently being mined across all probes. On each probe's detailed view, the Production value will show how much Miranium can be mined from that location. Extracted Miranium is received at certain intervals during gameplay. There is a limit on the amount that can be stored, which can be increased by placing Storage Probes. Miranium is used in a variety of purposes, such as accelerating R&D development for Arms Manufa

Meredith & Co. (Japanese: , Meredesu & Kō) is a product Arms Manufacturer in . This startup is seeking to open a new era of weapons development based on tech obtained from the Ganglion. Its CEO is Louis R. Damon. This AM is unlocked upon completion of Chapter 4. Their equipment uses ether technology, which is difficult to work with. Perhaps that is why stability is lacking.

Millepods (Japanese: , Mirepēda) are flying Insectoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like huge centipedes. There are only three known Millepods; two Tyrants and a Mission Exclusive Enemy. They can be found in Noctilum, Oblivia, and Cauldros.

Mirage Adseculas (Japanese: , Mirāju Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 42-43 along the winding mountain trail in Cauldros north of of M'gando Gorge.

The Milsaadi Destroyers (Japanese: , Disuto Mirusādo) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Milsaadi Ganglion and are fought at level 20 at the West Janpath Plain in Primordia during the Affinity Mission A False Hope.
Millesaur Larynges are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Millesaurs by destroying their "true head" on their body appendage.

Cole, originally known as Minoth (Japanese: , Minochi), is a character in . He is an elderly man who lives in Fonsa Myma, the capital of the Kingdom of Uraya. He is a playwright, and the leader of the troupe that performs at the Mymoma Playhouse. He is the caretaker of Iona, and used to be a mercenary along with Vandham. He is also a Flesh Eater; his Blade weapons are a pair of daggers, although he is only known to possess one at the time he meets Rex. In , Minoth (his former name) is a Special Legendary Blade. He can grant tremendous power to Addam and his allies. Minoth uses the dark element, wields Gunknives, and acts as an Attacker in battle.

Messet Point (Japanese: , Misetto-misaki) is a location in . It is located on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago, southwest of the Fonsett Residential Area. There is a Salvage Point here. There are no enemies here aside from during School is in Session.

Mia Pippitos (Japanese: , Mīa Pipitto) are enemies in . They are members of the Pippito family and can be found at level 11-13 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly at Seigle Fell. They also have a chance of spawning at level 3-4 when a Gorian Buloofo with low HP uses the "Beast Howl" ability.

Mk. VI Gerolf (Japanese: , Dairokusedai no Gevaruto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a Sovereign that can be found at level 66 at the Alioth, Elevator #3 in the World Tree. It must be defeated to unlock Poppibuster's level 4 "Superstrength".

Modeling Work (Japanese: , E no Moderu) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Forestry", "Fortitude" and "One Lucky Gal" Field Skills.

Mock Maneuvers (Japanese: , Mogi Enshū Kunren) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 4 and the nation reaches 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery", "Chivalry" and "Titan Weapon Wisdom" Field Skills.

Mining Machine is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 60 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Industry Mastery", "Mineralogy" and "Transport Mastery" Field Skills.

Misimisi is a Nopon in . She is a mineral appraiser with a history in identifying gemstones, and can be found on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. She has a large role in Precious Yearnings, where she identifies mineral samples for Agate. Misimisi gives no quests or merc missions.

Military Training is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal by talking to Yevesthenes at the Capital Approach, when the nation has at least 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fortitude", "Electric Mastery" and "Chivalry" Field Skills.

Mermaid-Blue Pandoria (Japanese: ) is a DLC Aux Core in . It increases damage dealt by 50% when the Affinity between Driver and Blade is at max. It also changes Pandoria appearance when she equips the core, granting her a blue color scheme. It can be purchased at the DLC shop Noponstone Exchange for 40 Noponstones in the Land of Challenge obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The Magical Pink Pandoria DLC Aux Core has an equivalent effect, which is functionally identical to the Affinity MAX Atk V Aux Core. The Devoted Marigold Nia DLC Aux Core has a stronger version of this equipment's effect
Mitia Lookout (Japanese: , Mitia Tenbōdai) is a Landmark in . It is located in the City.
The Module Warehouse (Japanese: , Mojūru Kakunōko) is a Landmark in , located in the City. It is where Cradles stolen from Keves and Agnus by the Lost Numbers are stored.

Metamorphosages are Collectible items in . They can be found in Swordmarch. They can also be purchased from the City Caravan, or produced from the Perimeter Outlet Fabricator after the first step of Colony 0 renovation.

Minstrel Gulkins are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Gulkin family, and can be found at level 43-45 on Daedal Isle and Corne Island, level 74 on Lavi Sandbar, and level 98-99 in the Malevolent Hollow in Erythia Sea.
Miclan is an NPC in . He was one of Colony Gamma's off-seers and Schoon's mentor before getting killed during the mission to destroy the Ouroboros Stone.
Mhamamia Antols are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 60 in the Antol Pit on Corne Island and at Cape Arcaphor in Erythia Sea.
Michiba is an NPC in who can be found in the City. She is the owner of Michiba Canteen.

Miyori is a NPC in who can be found in the City. She is in charge of the Material Storage Warehouse. While she belongs to the conservative faction, she discreetly assists the Ouroboros and liberal factions.
Minstrel Tirkins are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 42 on the Black Mountains.

Mud Squirrels (Japanese: , Dororisu) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they secrete a protective oil on their skin and they are great little swimmers.

Moon Flowers (Japanese: , Kokōmawari) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they are large round lofty blue flower and all other blooms fade when they open.
Mountain Spears (Japanese: , Sankai no Yari) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are swords wielded by Dunban. They can be acquired by purchasing them at Colony 6 Shop 6 for 21,420 G.
Moonlit Defenders (Japanese: , Getsuei no Gotō) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are swords wielded by Dunban.

Moramora Meat Pies are rare materials in . They cannot be traded for, and can be dropped by Moramoras on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they were originally a cuisine of the Chilkins and they are also known as Old Man Livers. Three of them are needed for Reversed Tastes.

The Morning Dew Ice is a Key Item required for Believing Again in Alcamoth. It can only be obtained at Befalgar Pedestal, a Secret Area on Valak Mountain, at dawn (5:00) once the quest is accepted. Believing Again is a Timed Quest that will expire after the events at Mechonis Core, this item will be therefore unavailable once Mechonis Core is cleared.
The Moonlight Book is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is required for The Coffin of Bafalgar. It can be found in the Soothsayer's Crypt in Tephra Cave at night.

The Moon (Japanese: , Kioku Kūkan - Tsuki) is a landmark in . It is located in Memory Space, and is one of the final locations in the game. The only enemy found here is Spirit - Gadolt, and there is a transporter to Sentient Genesis.

Mumkhar's Razors are rare materials in . They presumably once belonged to Mumkhar himself, and can only be obtained by trading with Kurralth whilst he is on Valak Mountain during Adventurers in Peril. According to their description, they can trim even the toughest bristles and they buzz like electric clippers.

Mortifoles (Japanese: , Foriumu) are flying flower-like insectoids enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are notorious for their usage of mimicry to camouflage themselves as flowers, catching many unwary BLADE agents by surprise. Some however may be found hovering in the air rather than lying in ambush. A similar species of insectoids are Sacrifoles.

Mountain Progen (Japanese: , Maunto Ekuusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Progen and can be found at level 41-44 on the Delusians North Summit in Sylvalum. They disappear during spore cloud weather.
Murras (Japanese: , Tondomu) are vaguely owl-like flying enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They could be considered counterparts of Vespers.
Mountain Sylooth (Japanese: , Maunto Shirūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sylooth family, and one can be found at level 45 on the Southern Searoad in Sylvalum.
Muscled Simius Bulges are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Simius, particularly by destroying their hand appendages. Three are needed for Indigen Investigation.

Mountain Jaculs (Japanese: , Maunto Hasutara) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Jacul family, and can be found at level 56-57 in Noctilum's Weeping Whitewood during the day.
Moon Blattas (Japanese: , Mūn Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 51-60 in the Drop Shaft in Primordia.

Moonlighting Elwyn (Japanese: , Kozukaikasegi no Roto) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Bunnit family and can be found at level 8 at the Plains of Evening Calm in the Gormott Province. It must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 2 "Leaping" Field Skill.

Muscley Damian (Japanese: , Gōwan no Wāgu) is a Unique Monster in . He is a member of the Buloofo family and can be found at level 43 inside the Sanguinous Grotto in the Kingdom of Tantal alongside two Nant Buloofos. It must be defeated to unlock Poppibuster's level 3 "Superstrength".

|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Moonbeam Bananas are Vegetable collectibles in and . In , they can be found in the Gormott Province, in particular from the Collection Points located near Dawnview Grotto or at Clear Sky Beak, while in , they can be found in Gormott, from the Collection Point directly north of the Torigoth Arch Skip Travel point.
Mountain Crusher (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using the Shield Hammer.

Money, Money, Money (Japanese: , Kane Kane Kane) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 3. The nation must also have at least 3 stars in Development Level for it to become available. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Botany", "Info Collector" and "Transport Mastery" Field Skills.
Mumufa is an NPC in . Mumufa is a Nopon who can be found on Goldmouth's Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. Mumufa runs an Informant shop specialized in information.

Murmur is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. He offers the Ticket to Mor Ardain for 3,000 G, allowing Rex and company to travel to the Empire of Mor Ardain for the first time.

Mysterious Lifeform is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Expeditionist" and "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills.

Muscle Mod is a Role CPU in . It grants Poppi an Attacker role with low defenses and average aggro generation. It offers a modifier that increases Tora's Strength stat by a percentage. It specializes in maximizing Physical damage, and can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. Poppi QTπ starts equipped with the rank II variant of this Role CPU by default. __TOC__

Muscle Power is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located at the Torigoth Relay Base in the Gormott Province. It features a conversation between Cressidus, his Driver and Mikhail. Choosing option one takes the player to the Secret Area Clear Sky Beak, while option two raises Mikhail's Trust by 100. It is unclear by how much these two options raise Cressidus's Trust, however.
The Mokmo Onion is a Key Item in . It can be obtained during the quest The Supply Situation from Lascham Island in the Gormott Province.
Monado Burst (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using the Monado. This art recycles Rex's Power Hammer.
Moongale Waltz (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using Knives. This art recycles Mòrag's Revolution Flash.

Mystery Launch Codes is a DLC Quest in . It is part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass. It can be received from an Ancient tablet in the Wall Power Control Room of the Land of Morytha after Chapter 10. Adenine's Lv 5 Extra-Ancient Wisdom and Lv 9 Keen Eye Field Skills are required to receive the quest.

Moramora Pearls are Enemy Part collectible items in . They can be dropped from Moramora enemies found at Peln, Pilgrim's Springland and Ancient Lakebed in the Kingdom of Torna, either flying or lining the walls.
Moondance (Japanese: ) is one of Lora's Rear Guard Arts in .
Mountain Front: Agnus (Japanese: , Yamamichi Sensen: Agunusu Jin'ei) is a Location in . It is located on the Urayan Trail in the Pentelas Region.
Mountain Front: Keves (Japanese: , Yamamichi Sensen: Kevesu Jin'ei) is a Location in . It is located on the Urayan Trail in the Pentelas Region.
The Mxene Tech Quarter (Japanese: , Makina Kōbōku) is a Location in . It is located in the City. Samon's workshop is located here. Gray can be found here when out of the party.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Moon Anklets are Accessories in . The common variant can be purchased from the O'Virbus Commissary, the legendary variant can be dropped by Stately Doramma.
Moonshadow (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Earth Bind that can only be used by Isurd.

The Mt. Nagul Viewing Deck (Japanese: , Naguru-san no Tenbōdai) is a Landmark in , located on the Black Mountains. It is accessed from Raxeal Lavaflow. An Ether Slide connecting to the Argan Cathedral Ruins can be constructed here.

The Moonbright Regiment Outpost (Japanese: , Tsukishiro Shidan Zenshō Kichi) is a location in . It is an Agnian Outpost located west of the Ferronis Crater on the Aurora Shelf. The gate can be opened with the Outpost Key found inside.
Mysterious Balls are Key Items in . They are two balls found around Prison Island during Ancient Contraption. The balls are meant to be placed in the mechanism in the Third Sanctum.
Moramoras (Japanese: , Moramora) are a family of flying enemies in the . This species is close to the Laia.

Nofol Tower (Japanese: , Nofuru no tō) is a landmark in . It is located on the lower level of Valak Mountain, southeast of the Great Glacier and southwest of Ignia Hill. The tower appears to be of High Entia architecture, and is circled by a frozen lake.

Nagul Waterfall (Japanese: , Naguru taki) is a location in . It is located on the upper level of Valak Mountain, south of the Mechonis Wound. It is inhabited by some Sparas Paguls and Monta Moramoras during the day. Lophos Moramoras emerge during the night. The Vague Barbas can also be found here, accompanied by a group of Reef Nebulae. There is an Ice Ether Crystal Deposit at the foot of the waterfall itself.

Nemeses were enemies in that had very high stats and potentially unique skills, comparable to Raid Bosses in other games. Nemeses had higher stats than Tyrants. Only two Nemeses are known, both Ultrafauna. With the shutdown of Wii U online services, the ability to fight nemeses was discontinued. They were fought during Squad Missions with a strict time limit. These battles required thorough personal and Squad team preparations for both characters and Skells. They had relatively low HP but could have had millions of lives, represented by RP. At the end of the mission, the Nemesis's remaining RP was reported to a server and was carried over to the next player who fought it. This went on until

The Noctilucent Sphere Interior (Japanese: , Yakōkyū-nai) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in southeastern Sylvalum. It is the interior of the massive Noctilucent Sphere, and is home to Pharsis, the Everqueen, the second most powerful enemy in the game. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Within the Noctilucent Sphere").
The Noctilum Waters (Japanese: , Yakō no Mori Kinkai) are a region in . These are the waters around the coasts of Noctilum, and contain several small islands.

Necro, the Cavelord (Japanese: , Dōketsu no Nekuro) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Vesper family. It can be found at level 69 in the bottommost part of Drop Shaft in Primordia, surrounded by a number of Carmine Vespers, Nocturnal Vespers, and Moon Blattas.

Na-mulk, the Rebellious (Japanese: , Hangyaku no Na-Muka) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Oc-serv machine. It can be found at level 47 between two piles of rubble at Ruined City of O'rrh Sim in Cauldros, just north of the Ganglion Antropolis visual marker. It lies dormant until approached.

Noctilum Trailblazing 1 (Japanese: , Yakō no Mori no Kaitaku 1) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is received automatically when Planetary Pioneer (Part II) is accepted.

The Night Combat Puge (Japanese: , Yasen-gata Berude) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Puge machine, a human-size Ganglion robot. It can be found at level 34 at the Ruined City of O'rrh Sim in Cauldros at night. It must be defeated to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Night Combat Puge.

Noctilum Trailblazing 2 (Japanese: , Yakō no Mori no Kaitaku 2) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is received automatically when Planetary Pioneer (Part II) is accepted.

Noctilum Trailblazing 3 (Japanese: , Yakō no Mori no Kaitaku 3) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is received automatically when Planetary Pioneer (Part II) is accepted.

Night Ruga Quadwings (Japanese: , Naitorugā Kurōdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family and can be found at level 13-17 flying above the Upper Level - Right and Upper Level - Left areas of Gormott Province at night and dry weather. Three them must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 1 "Phase Transition Tech" on her affinity chart.

New Book is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal by talking to Sophonea by the Library Philosofia, when the nation has at least 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Entomology", "Mineralogy" and "Ancient Wisdom" Field Skills.

The Nenz Rodonya (Japanese: , Nonon Mūsu) is a quest-exclusive enemy in . It is a member of the Rodonya family, and can be found at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain during the quest Flames of Justice.
Nils is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti found near the Saets Chief's Residence in Torigoth in the Gormott Province during Star-Crossed Lovers. He is Carys and Wyn's son and Rhiannon's brother.
Nils's Medicine is a Key Item in . It is received from Nils during Star-Crossed Lovers.

New Sounds (Japanese: , Atarashii Neiro) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Empire of Mor Ardain for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Production Mastery", "Expeditionist" and "Harmony" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Casta-Mutes in Strummer Instruments * Mumuni the Littlepon in Reedirait Bookstore

Night Visitors is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago by talking to Stippon who walks around Fonsett Residential Area near Fonsett Arch, when the nation has 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Electric Mastery", "Info Collector" and "Assassination" Field Skills.
Near Lascham Island in Gormott Province is a Salvage Point in . __TOC__

Naiti-Naits are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They are mushrooms that cause overpowering drowsiness when ingested. The Yellowgrove Kelp Mushrooms are revealed to actually be Naiti-Naits after they are collected.
Nagul Pods are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are Arachno Pods that can be found at level 43 on the Black Mountains.

Ocean Elixirs of Life (Japanese: , Umi-ō no Chōju Kabayaki) are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by two high-level Lexos in Colony 6 and Makna Forest. These enemies do not appear until after the battle in Mechonis Core. It can also be traded for with two NPCs once the aforementioned event has taken place. According to their description, drinking them increases one's lifespan and celebrities use them to live longer. One is needed for Replica Monado 2, and another for the reconstruction of Colony 6. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 7,900 Noponstones.

The Nopon Sage (Japanese: , Nopon Sennin) is a Nopon in . He is a legend that little Nopon believe in. He turns out to be real, discovered during Pipiki's quest to give him food, Meeting the Nopon Sage available after preparing ingredients during Honouring the Nopon Sage. He only appears when there is a rainbow visible in front of the Great Makna Falls, at the Divine Sanctuary. He will appear between 12:00 and 15:00. He is 9,999 years old. The Nopon Sage gives the party a quest chain that makes Riki the second True Heropon. The first quest involves information about him from two little Nopon. One of them says that he is greedy while the other says that he is powerful. His second quest makes

The Nopon Camp (Japanese: , Nopon kyanpu) is a landmark in . It is located on the lower level of Valak Mountain. It is found at the end of the tunnel from Hollow Bone, just west of the pool which the party lands in. It is very close to the hard-to-find Antol Den. There are some Nopon Researchers here who will give some quests, and there is also a shop here, manned by a male Nopon Merchant.

Offensive Seeker Units are Mechon enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found at level 56 on the Fallen Arm. There are similar looking Mechon on the Fallen Arm as well as at Mechonis Field. These Mechon can be found at the Connecting Bridge. Defeating four of them is required to complete the quest A Tough Battle given by Kazat in the Hidden Machina Village. Additionally, they can drop the Refined Part Ms needed for Restoring the Capital 2. Two Story Exclusive variants appear at level 52 at Power Pipe Ruins on the Fallen Arm. They must be defeated by Sharla and Reyn as part of a story event not long after the party arrives on the Fallen Arm. This variant does not carry or drop any trea

Noto Feris (Japanese: , Noto Ferisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 44 in the Lava Cave on Valak Mountain. They are the only enemies that drop Feris Aged Ale, one lot of which is required for The Freezing Nopon.

Nopon Determination (Japanese: , Nopon no Iji) is a quest in . It can be received from Mefimefi in Colony 6. This quest and Homs Determination are mutually exclusive. This quest is not available if Perrine was invited to Colony 6, since she and Mefimefi are mutually exclusive in the repopulating of Colony 6. Odd Smoke - Resolution must have been completed. A 3-star affinity with Colony 6 is necessary to trigger this quest. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. Mefimefi gives this quest because Jer'ell is doubting the utility of the sleeping Armus at the farm that was built as a part of the Special reconstruction of Colony 6. However, Mefimefi still has faith in the Armus' potentia
The Obelis Obart (Japanese: , Oberisu Hobāto) is a boss in . It is a member of the Obart family, and can be found at level 75 in the Arena in Prison Island, along with the Demon Pavlovsk.
Obarts (Japanese: , Hobāto) are a family of winged bipedal enemies in , found only on Prison Island. Only three types of Obart are known, with two of them being Story-Event creatures.

Obart Obarts (Japanese: , Hobāto Hobāto) are enemies in . They are members of the Obart family, and can be found around level 76 on Prison Island. An Obart Obart's Talent Art is Legendary Claw VII. The Obart flies up in front of the party and strikes with its right claw as it flies down, inflicting Daze.

Offensive Security Units are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Mechon, and can be found at level 56 at Connecting Bridge on the Fallen Arm. They can drop the Refined Part Ms needed for Restoring the Capital 2. Two Story Exclusive variants appear at level 52 at Power Pipe Ruins on the Fallen Arm. They must be defeated by Sharla and Reyn as part of a story event not long after the party arrives on the Fallen Arm. This variant does not carry or drop any treasure.

Obstinate Berryjammy (Japanese: , Ijipparina Sutorojamu) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Norara at a balcony of a building from the Reconstruction HQ in Colony 6. If Riki is in the active party, he will comment. Unstoppable Berryjammy will be triggered upon completing this quest.
The Nopon Camp Shop is a shop in . It is the second shop located on Valak Mountain, at the Nopon Camp. It sells a few more armour pieces than the Zokhed Pass Shop, as well as two arts manuals.

The Oblivia Ingress (Japanese: , Keikoku Iriguchi, Valley Entrance) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in the westernmost region of Oblivia, thus making it, as the name suggests, the first area in the continent the player reaches upon entering from Primordia.

Oc-servs (Japanese: , Me-tsuu) are machine enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are mysterious Miran flying drones with two long arms and a single glowing eye. They can be found in all regions. Oc-servs are immune to all weather effects, and their detection is not hampered by electromagnetic storms.

]] Nopon Commerce Guild (Japanese: , Nopon Shōkai) is a commercial Arms Manufacturer in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This enterprise is part of the Nopon Commerce Guild, which originally began by trading fruits and nuts. Its CEO is Elder Nan. The Nopon Commerce Guild does not produce armor. This AM is unlocked upon completion of the Affinity Mission BFFs. Nearly all of their weapons have thermal attributes. Many models are modified for greater magazine capacity.

Ocean Forfexes (Japanese: , Ōshan Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 41-43 or at level 46 at the Ensanguined Font in Noctilum.

Ocean Lophids (Japanese: , Ōshan Rofiru) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Lophid family, and can be found at level 41-50 at Janpath Lake (at night, sleeping in a tree), FN Site 109, and around the rock formation in the water near Castaway Cavern in Primordia. Three of them must be defeated during Laying Lophids Low.

O'rrh Sim Castle (English dub: ) is a massive structure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a complex of ancient ruins in Cauldros which is being used by the Ganglion as their main base of operations on Mira. The castle is divided into multiple sections: * O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins * O'rrh Sim Gate * O'rrh Sim Keep * O'rrh Sim Watchtowers * O'rrh Sim Capital Remains * Ruined City of O'rrh Sim * Beneath O'rrh Sim Keep * Capital Wreckage * Ganglion Weapons Hangar
The Oblivia Waters (Japanese: , Bōkyaku no Keikoku Kinkai) are a region in . These are the waters around the coasts of Oblivia, and contain one small island to the far south-east.

Olegario, the Iron-Helmed (Japanese: , Tetsukabuto no Oregario) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Suid family. It can be found at level 50 in Noctilum, within Whale's Weeper, during the night and late night. Sacrum, the Noctilucent and Seti, the Light of Stars are located in the same spot at the same time.
Ocean Purgovents (Japanese: , Ōshan Morumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Purgovent family, and can be found at level 41-50 at FN Site 314 and FN Site 316 in Oblivia.
Ocean Xiphias (Japanese: , Ōshan Rumederu) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Xiphias family, and can be found at level 41-50 in Noctilum, near FN Site 218.

Oblivia Trailblazing 2 (Japanese: , Bōkyaku no Keikoku no Kaitaku 2) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. It is automatically received upon accepting Planetary Pioneer (Part III).

Oblivia Trailblazing 1 (Japanese: , Bōkyaku no Keikoku no Kaitaku 1) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. It is automatically received upon accepting Planetary Pioneer (Part III).

Oblivia Trailblazing 3 (Japanese: , Bōkyaku no Keikoku no Kaitaku 3) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty in the Commercial District of New Los Angeles. It is automatically received upon accepting Planetary Pioneer (Part III).

The Old Plumbing Entrance (Japanese: , Kyūhaikankō Deguchi) is a Landmark in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. The Old Pluming Entrance can be reached from the Mine Elevator Skip Travel point on the Upper Level of Mor Ardain, by calling the elevator to the platform, riding it down, and then exiting the elevator to the left. The ladder into the large pipe must be climbed and the Thermal Exhaust Fork is reached by continuing forward. There is a valve with a Field Skill check that keeps the door shut. It requires Super Strength Level 3 and Fortitude Level 2 to open the door. The Secret Area is accessible by proceeding through the door and heading all the way to the

The Old City of Teddim (Japanese: , Eruguria Kyūshigai) is a Location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. This place is on separate ledges and walkways and is accessed via the Old Industrial District. Heading to the top of this location and along the narrow cliff leads to a Secret Area. The main enemies found here are Ignas, including their leader, the Unique Monster Decapitator Marvin.

Old Man Caskel's Tree (Japanese: , Ōki Kusukiri) is a location in . It is located on the furthest north-west point of Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago. There are no enemies or NPCs here except Foorara, who visits as his eighth stop on Foorara's Walky-Walky. There is an excavation point here which yields a white Treasure Trove containing a common Sapphire, two Rare Core Crystals, and Gold. It requires the Field Skills Earth Mastery level 4 and Keen Eye level 6 to excavate.

The Old Gelgemos Gate (Japanese: , Kyū Gerugeimu no Seimon-ato) is a location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, east of the Tamie Pillars Skip Travel Point, directly below Pillar City Ruins, although the Upper Level cannot be accessed from here. It is also one of the homes for the Tantal Tirkin. Sandstream uses this as a hideout during Flames of Justice.

Olstepriniums are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in Temperantia, in particular from the Collection Points located near the Ruined Chapel of Danafas to the north of Central Plain, and on the island at the Toxbloom Spring.

Nopon Veggie Stir-Fry (Japanese: , Nopon Tokusei Yasaiitame) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Nopon Wisdom" and "Production Mastery" Field Skills.

Nopon Letter is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 2 and the nation reaches 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Transport Mastery" Field Skills.

Norman is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who is first found on Melnath's Shoulder in Gormott Province alongside his lover Rhiannon, and approaching them automatically triggers Star-Crossed Lovers. Depending on how the party finishes the aforementioned quest, he and Rhiannon will relocate to either the Grodd Residential Zone in Torigoth or the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Ookiooki is a NPC in . She is a Nopon who can be found shaking by the lifeless body of Sulala at Rigitte Harbor in the Leftherian Archipelago during Go for it, Electra!. Ookiooki explains that Sulala was meant to guide her around Leftheria, but got overexcited and hit her head which caused her heart to stop. Ookiooki then requests Electra revive her with her electricity to restart her heart. Doing so requires level 7 "Electric Mastery", and level 3 "Mastery of Thunder".

Old Routes (Japanese: , Inishie no Kōro) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Kingdom of Tantal for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Transport Mastery", "Ice Mastery" and "Miasma Dispersal" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Tasty Kordeth Samod in Rumbletum Canteen * Clicky-Clacks in Strummer Instruments

Nopon News (Japanese: , Nopon Shinbun) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Girls' Talk", "Ancient Wisdom" and "Info Collector" Field Skills.

Nopon Pop Stars (Japanese: , Nopon-tachi no Aidoru) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula obtains 500 fans. The time required to complete this mission is 20 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 5 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's attributes. It also increases Ursula's fanbase by a significant amount.

Nopon Cooking is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Production Mastery", "Info Collector" and "Nopon Wisdom" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Veg & Oyster Aspic in Corcaja Greengrocers * Fragrant Samod Stralu in Speck Butchers * Noponcho in Future Crafts

Olua is an NPC in . She is a humanoid female Common Blade who grants power to her Driver Reid. She can be found on Baldotas Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago. She attempts to give Reid training to help him become a better Driver, despite his reluctance.
The Not-safe-for-work Folio is a Key Item in . It can be obtained at the Gwenith Paddies in the Kingdom of Uraya during the DLC Blade Quest Shiny New Power.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Ocean Earrings (Japanese: , Taikai no Piasu) are DLC accessories in . They boost the wearer's resistance to Party Gauge draining attacks by up to 70%. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. The DLC exclusive Seven-Seas Earring accessory offers a stronger instance of this equipment's effect.
Ocean Eyes are Ore collectible items in . They can be found in the Kingdom of Torna.

Normal Missions (Japanese: , Normal Quest) are a type of mission in , and typically have several objectives. They are requests to solve the personal problems of the residents of New Los Angeles. They can be received by talking to NPCs who have a "!" icon over their head, or by approaching a particular location. In some cases there is a corresponding Basic Mission which, although not a prerequisite, signals the availability of a Normal Mission and can guide the player to the place where it can be received. Any number of Normal Missions may be accepted and in progress simultaneously, and cannot be abandoned after they are accepted. Some Normal Missions are part of a series involving the same c

Noponic Destruction (Japanese: , Noponikku desutoroi, Lit. "Noponic Destroy") is Poppi QT's Level III Blade Special in . Noponic Destruction is also Poppi QT's Special Art during Merc Assault missions in the .

Oceanic Lucera (Japanese: , Meikai no Rūshera) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Moramora family, and can be found at level 73 at Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea. The Bomberhead Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.
Ocean Polyps are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.
Olive (Japanese: , Oriibu) is a character in who can be found in the City.

Ocean Day Parade is a Time Attack Challenge Battle in . It can be received from Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the second part of the Expansion Pass. Clearing this challenge with at least an A rank for the first time will unlock the Swimwear B outfit for Noah.

Orluga Grass Skirts are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by various Orluga in Makna Forest and can be traded for in Frontier Village, Makna Forest, and briefly in Alcamoth. According to their description, though it is unhygienic, the Orluga wash them every couple of days. Five of them are needed for Material Quest 2 in Alcamoth.

Palti Kromars (Japanese: , Paruti Supikaru) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Kromar family, and can be found at level 35 in the Eryth Sea, on Hovering Reefs 6, 7 and 8, and Soltnar Seal Island. Five Palti Kromars must be defeated for the Eryth Sea quest Monster Quest 1.

Otol Kromars (Japanese: , Otoru Supikaru) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Kromar family, and can be found at level 39 on Soltnar Seal Island in the Eryth Sea. Five of them must be defeated for Alcamoth's Monster Quest 4 - Part 3.

Ories Horns are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can only be dropped by Ories and Agile Barbatos on Valak Mountain, and cannot be traded for. According to their description, they are large horns that emit a majestic light and shine even brighter at night. Two are required for Medical Advancements.

Pagul Hot Pots are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Paguls in Eryth Sea, or traded for in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are extremely delicious hot pots with the divinely salty taste of the ocean. Five are needed for Losing the Taste for Alcohol.

Pagul Cold Pies are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are only dropped by Sparas Paguls on Valak Mountain. They are not available for trade. According to their description, the cooler they get the more they cook and they have cold exteriors and warm centres. Three of them are needed for A Tantalising Treat.

Path to the Top (Japanese: , Chōjō e no Michi) is a Story Quest in . It is received automatically after the story event while arriving at the Corridor of Silence during the normal progression through Prison Island for the second time. The second objective of the quest involves the boss battle against the Dragon King Alcar at the Corridor of Silence and requires to defeat it.

Overtrade is a game mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles. Overtrade can occur when a higher-priced item from the party leader is traded for a lower-priced item from a named NPC. Each named NPC carries a bonus item. If the difference between the higher-priced item and the lower-priced item is equal to or greater than the value of the bonus item, the party leader will receive the bonus item. For example: In Colony 6, Gorman offers a Dobercorgi as an overtrade item. The Dobercorgi is valued at 7,020 G, so Shulk has to trade for an item whereby the difference between the values of the two items is 7,020 G. Assuming that the reputation value of Colony 6 is at 1 star and there are no trading skill bon

Papils (Japanese: , Papirio) are butterfly-like creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in all five regions. They are similar to Adseculas and Turbas, and share some Arts and material names.

The Oratory Knoll Cemetery (Japanese: , Orashion Kyūbo) is a location in . It is a small graveyard located on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago, just outside Fonsett Village. Rex's parents are buried here. The Heart-to-Heart "By the Graveside", between Rex, Pyra and Azurda, can be viewed here.

Overdrive Protocols are Key Items in . Each one allows a single Blade to be permanently transferred from one Driver to another. They can be used from the Blade menu. All affinity points and unlocked upgrades will be included and also applied to the new driver during the overdrive process. Once Rex unlocks the abilities of the Master Driver, overdriving Blades onto him will no longer be an option. 10 of these are also gifted to players who have purchased the Expansion Pass. In the , Overdrive Protocols can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Panpan is an NPC in . He can be found on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. Panpan gives the quest Into the Open Sky.

Parisax Extermination is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills.

Papillon Dance (Japanese: , Papiyondansu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using Brilliant Twinblades. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Nia's Butterfly Blade.
The Orem Storage Ward (Japanese: , Horeumu Kakunōku, Horreum Storage Ward) is a location in . It is located in the northeastern area of Auresco, and is next to the city's rear gate.
The Peach Slate Piece is a Key Item in . It can be found south of the opening that leads to the Holy Gate of Altana and down the destroyed set of steps next to the crater.
Ouroboros (Japanese: , Uroborosu) is a subgroup of people, as well as a power, in and .
Orson is an NPC and in who can be found in Colony 15, and later in the City.
The Ouroboros Stones are objects in and . They have the ability to turn people into Ouroboros.

Peacebringer Divalo (Japanese: , Meimoku no Onsha-ō Dibarou, Divalo, the Pardon Lord of the Peaceful Death) is a Superboss in . It is a Gyrinus type Levnis Unique Monster that can be found at level 90 at the Colony Gamma Wreckage in Vermilion Woods after reaching the Black Mountains. It is a member of the Slow 'n' Steadies duo alongside Stronghammer Dorga.
The Outpost Key is a Key Item in . It is found at the Moonbright Regiment Outpost, behind the front gate. It is used to open the front gate.

Our Paths May Never Cross is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track ten of the Xenoblade 2: Torna ~ The Golden Country Original Soundtrack, and track ten of disc eleven from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It is a remix of The Power of Jin. This song plays during the final battle against Gort in Spessia.

Parting is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track sixteen of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track sixteen of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It uses a motif from Elysium, in the Blue Sky. This track plays during the ending when Rex desperately tries to get Poppi to take him across the destroyed bridge to be with Pneuma, with Azurda, Mòrag, and Zeke trying to convince him to accept Pneuma's decision.

Our Hope is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track fifteen of disc five from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track fifteen of disc ten from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. It uses motifs from Xenoblade II - Where It All Began - and Elysium, in the Blue Sky. This track plays during the ending when Rex realizes Pneuma's intention to sacrifice herself to destroy the World Tree in order to save Alrest.

The Poison Swamp (Japanese: , Dokuhaki-numa) is a location in . It is located in Satorl Marsh. It is a swamp, and just like Dark Swamp the party takes damage while they are in the purple liquid. It is located just south of Zaldania Waterfall, and northeast from Crown Tree. This is one of the two swamps where Poison Brogs are found on the islands.

Poleaxe Chilkins (Japanese: , Bogūn Chirukin) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Chilkin family and can be found at level 41 - 44 in the Url Crevasse and north of Bagnar Snowfield on Valak Mountain. They are one group of monsters in Chilkins and Antols, where five of them must be defeated. They can drop the Aged Chilkin Hairs needed for A Token of Friendship.

Pelargos Ekidnos (Japanese: , Perarugosu Ekidona) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Ekidno family, and can be found at level 40 on Khatorl Seal Island and Hode Refuge in the Eryth Sea. One of them must be defeated to complete Alcamoth's Monster Quest 3 - Part 3. They can drop Ekidno Jaw Gristles, which are needed for Getting Bigger!

Plasma Deinoses (Japanese: , Tonitoru Dinosu) are enemies in . They are members of the Deinos family, and can be found from level 29-32 in Makna Forest near the Eks Watering Hole. They have an electrical frill on their backs, similar to the fiery frills on Inferno Deinos. Defeating five of them is required to complete the quest Lousy Lizards given by Modamo in Frontier Village. They can drop the Peachy Leg Joints needed for Leku's Food Crisis, and the Magic Stones needed for Material Quest 1.

Peerless (Japanese: , Tenkamusō) is one of Dunban's arts in . When this aura is activated, it increases Strength and removes Confuse for nearby party members. It also adds volatile aggro to nearby enemies.

Pods (Japanese: , Poddo) are a family of enemies in the . Pods are unusual in that they hold other enemies, which emerge when the pod is destroyed or at low health. Pods undergo little change between games, although they become finer and more web-like in and due to graphics improvement.

The Pojics is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be obtained from Olga during Unstoppable Berryjammy and is one of two options for completing the quest, the other being to collect ingredients for Bitter Pojics.

Planetary Pioneer (Part I) (Japanese: , Wakusei Mira no Kaitaku Sono 1) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty at the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District of New Los Angeles.

Pharsis, the Everqueen (Japanese: , Yūhi Farushisu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Yggralith and can be found hanging from the ceiling in the Noctilucent Sphere Interior in Sylvalum. At level 97, it is the second most powerful Tyrant in the game after Telethia, the Endbringer, and the highest-leveled enemy in Sylvalum. It is the only Yggralith that can be fought outside of missions. During battles with Pharsis, the Everqueen, the boss theme "CR17S19S8" plays instead of the standard Tyrant theme "Uncontrollable".

Plasma Duoguills (Japanese: , Purazuma Guira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Duoguill family and can be found at level 59-60 in Sylvalum located in the ocean north of FN Site 401.

Piernus, the Scorcher (, Shakunetsu no Pierunasu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Petramand family. It can be found at level 57 in the lava river east of Ruined City of O'rrh Sim in Cauldros during the day.

Planetes, the Torrential (Japanese: , Ōtaki no Puranetesu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Unafulge family. It can be found at level 50 at the crimson-tipped peak directly west of Celestial Cleave in Noctilum. Killing it is required for Segment Recon.

Pistolia Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Meredith & Co. Dual Guns. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Pollution Solution. The Pistolia weapons available in-game are: * Storm Pistolia * Soldier Pistolia * Warrior Pistolia * Delta Pistolia * Destroyer Pistolia * Ophidian Pistolia * Striker Pistolia * Cosmic Pistolia * Nebulan Pistolia

Piscinoids (Japanese: , Megafurai) are a category of enemy in . It includes all aquatic enemies, notably creatures that resemble fishes, cetaceans, cnidarians, and mollusks. Piscinoids can be found wherever a source of water is available, living around coastlines, but also in rivers and pools, and even in desert oasis' and flooded caves. With twelve varieties on Mira, the biodiversity of the species is narrow in comparison to other enemy types. All Piscinoids are airborne when above water, and as such, share a common weakness to Gravity damage, but their primary weakness is Electricity based attacks and they have no natural resistances, with the exception of a few specific species, Tyrants u

The Pipe Maintenance Office (Japanese: , Haikan Kyūseibishitsu) is a Location in . It is located on the Lower Level of the Empire of Mor Ardain. The office can be accessed from the hallway after the Thermal Exhaust Fork. A valve with a Field Skill check blocks the door to the office, requiring Fortitude level 2 and Super Strength level 3 to open. Inside, the room will be completely dark until the player clears another Field Skill check, requiring Electric Mastery level 1 and Light Mastery level 1. Clearing the field skill check will turn the lights back on in the room, revealing a level 30 Brish Aspar in between a Treasure Trove and a Collection Point.

The Pillar City Ruins (Japanese: , Hōjō no Kyū Shichū Toshi) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal, between the Gates of Ulcaria and the Sealed Quarry. The Old Gelgemos Gate is directly below the ruins and can be reached by jumping down the ice platforms, although there is no way to get back up from here. The Airborne Throne Secret Area is directly above the ruins, and can be reached by climbing and jumping with level 7 Wind Mastery, level 4 Earth Mastery and level 5 Leaping field skills.
Piros Crustips (Japanese: , Pirosu Shuribu) are enemies in . They are level 24 – 28 members of the Crustip family and can appear when salvaging on the Maelstrom or Goldmouth Flight Deck in Argentum.

Pengs (Japanese: , Pengu) are a family of enemies in . They are flying bird-like enemies found exclusively in the Kingdom of Tantal, where they come in black and white varieties. They are similar in size and shape to Puffots.
Plambuses (Japanese: , Mosūn) are a family of enemies in the . They resemble gigantic flying beetles and come in green and red varieties, the latter exclusive to the Kingdom of Torna.
Planet Spheres are Treasure items in . They can be salvaged at the Argentum Trade Guild at any Argentum Salvage Point.
Peri Puffots (Japanese: , Perīn Shigaru) are enemies in . They are members of the Puffot family and can be found at level 19-23 flying above Farlaine Wells in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Pinfins are Fish collectibles in . They can be found in the Leftherian Archipelago, in particular from a Collection Point near Baldotas Isle with the "Ichthyology" field skill. Just in front of the landmark by the lake is where they can be found, however they can also be found on the other side of the island in smaller quantities. Not only that but this item can also be found on the near by the Isle of Sleeping Remains. In the , Pinfins can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo. Ten are needed during A Phonex Tale.

Phantom Fruit (Japanese: , Maboroshi no Kajitsu) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Botany", "Entomology" and "One Lucky Gal" Field Skills.

Pest Extermination is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Agronomy" and "Ice Mastery" Field Skills.

Pending Payout is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago by talking to Hazel near Fonsett Village, when the nation has at least 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Industry Mastery", "Lockpicking" and "Focus" Field Skills.

Persevering Strength is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It restores Tora's HP by up to 12% of the damage dealt with each successful Auto-Attack hit. Double Attack effects such as those on the Double Attack Skill RAM and certain Cube accessories will also generate additional healing for each repeated hit. It is equivalent in effect to the Garnet, Sapphire, Diamond and Alexandrite accessories. It can be used to customize Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. Poppi α is not compatible with this part. __TOC__

Pilum Tirkin (Japanese: , Pirumu Tākin) are two Quest Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 43 along with two Ankl Tirkin on Daram Isle of the Leftherian Archipelago, then at the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild applying assistance to the Tirkin King during the Quest Birds of a Feather.
Planetary Crystals are Ore collectible items in . They can be found in Gormott, in particular from the Collection Point found by going to Hoary Weald Camp and finding the mineral deposit there.

Perturbed Bilkin (Japanese: , Kakuran no Birukin) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Flier family and can be found at level 13 on Viliera Hill in Millick Meadows. The Butterfly Dust Art can be earned by the Soulhacker class by defeating it.

Prado Upas are enemies in . They are members of the Upa family, and can be found at levels 55 - 56. It is a normal enemy that can be found in the water area near the ether mining area south of the 5th Pulse Zone on the Fallen Arm. Four of them need to be defeated to complete Powerless. They can drop the Electric Upa Tears needed for The Wilted Flower.

Powerless (Japanese: , Muryoku) is a quest in . It can be received from Rakzet after completing the quest I Want to be a Homs!. He can be found near the connected land southwest of the Junks in the Hidden Machina Village. If Sharla is in the active party, she will comment.

The Prison Gate (Japanese: , Kangokutō Jōmon) is a landmark in . It is located on the ground floor of Prison Island. This location differs at the middle of the story progression, during the midgame visits, and at the end of the game with several changes involving new transporters, enemies as well as Collectables.

Porcu Hoxes (Japanese: , Pōkyu Hoggusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Hox family and can be found at level 43 in the Lava Cave on Valak Mountain. They drop Hox Flints, three of which are needed for the quest The Freezing Nopon.

Power Supply Area 2 (Japanese: , Dai-2 Dengen Kukaku) is a location in . It is located on the fourth floor of Mechonis Field, and is inhabited by a M45/VIOLA. If attacked, it can summon two other Mechon — an Offensive/SCOUT and an Offensive/HONEY. M66/TRICK can also be found in this location.
Power Dive is a Support Battle Art in . It grants Supercharge effect and provides total evasion during this art execution. This animation also moves the character forward slightly.

Precious Resources are rare materials and crystals in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found on the planet Mira, and can be mined from certain Miranium deposits by installed a Data Probe. This probe can automatically extract them. They are known as Rare Resources in the Japanese version.
Primer is one of many Support Arts in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Tension by 200 and grants Critical Power.

Primordia Trailblazing 1 (Japanese: , Gensho no Kōya no Kaitaku 1) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is received automatically when Planetary Pioneer (Part I) is accepted.

Primordia Trailblazing 2 (Japanese: , Gensho no Kōya no Kaitaku 2) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is automatically received upon accepting Planetary Pioneer (Part I).

Primordia Trailblazing 3 (Japanese: , Gensho no Kōya no Kaitaku 3) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Kirsty on the BLADE Concourse in the Administrative District. It is automatically received upon acceptance of Planetary Pioneer (Part I).

Prisoner Caro (Japanese: , Purizun Nokkusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caro family and can be found at level 41 north of FN Site 416 and at Lower Delusian Mountains in Sylvalum.
Prone Butchers (Japanese: , Baiasu Choppā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 31-40 on the islands of Primordia Waters.
Productivity Power-Up is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Male Mechanic and the primary destination is Noctilum.
